rewards.redemption_notes: Free Spirit points had no expiration on active accounts and supported points pooling. Following Spirit Airlines' 2025 restructuring, the loyalty program has been wound down; Free Spirit points are no longer redeemable per public reporting (2026).

benefits.title: 5,000 Anniversary Bonus Points
benefits.description: 5,000 bonus points each account anniversary after spending $10,000 or more on purchases in the prior anniversary year.

benefits.title: 25% Inflight Purchase Rebate
benefits.description: 25% back as points on eligible Spirit Airlines inflight food and beverage purchases made with the card.

benefits.title: Zone 2 Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Zone 2 priority boarding on Spirit Airlines flights.

benefits.title: Points Pooling
benefits.description: Ability to pool Free Spirit points with other members.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the U.S.

notes: No-annual-fee entry-level Spirit co-brand: Free Spirit Travel Mastercard (World Mastercard issued by Bank of America). Earns 2X on Spirit Airlines purchases, 1X on all else. No foreign transaction fee. 5,000 anniversary bonus points after $10,000 annual spend. The official BofA product page redirects to the general credit-cards listing and is no longer serviceable; card details verified via Frequent Miler and Bankrate. Following Spirit Airlines' 2025 restructuring the card is no longer available to new applicants and Free Spirit points are reported to no longer be redeemable (2026); record retained for historical/BIN reference.
